argv:
INSTALL_DIR='/home/neel/Desktop/recovery_s1024_20261001T060514ZJ/install'
      export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$INSTALL_DIR/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
      cnt=$($INSTALL_DIR/bin/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres -tAc 'SELECT count(*) FROM usertable_small')
      if [[ '1' -eq 1 ]]; then
        merkle_sync=$($INSTALL_DIR/bin/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres           -tAc 'SHOW merkle_apply_synchronous_direct' | tr -d '[:space:]')
        if [[ "$merkle_sync" != on ]]; then
          echo "synchronous Merkle verification expected merkle_apply_synchronous_direct=on, got $merkle_sync" >&2
          exit 1
        fi
        root=$($INSTALL_DIR/bin/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres -tAc "SELECT merkle_root_hash('usertable_small')")
        verify=$($INSTALL_DIR/bin/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres -tAc "SELECT merkle_verify('usertable_small')")
        data_md5=$($INSTALL_DIR/bin/psql -X -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5448 -U postgres postgres -tAc "SELECT md5(string_agg(ycsb_key::text || field1 || field2 || field3 || field4 || field5 || field6 || field7 || field8 || field9 || field10, ',' ORDER BY ycsb_key)) FROM usertable_small")
      else
        root=disabled
        verify=disabled
        data_md5=disabled
      fi
      echo "$cnt|$root|$verify|$data_md5"
